name: 98001 · Auburn, WA
findings: ZIP 98001 (Auburn) has 96 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98001 (Auburn) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
